_comment: R8: downloadable curriculum packs. Fetched over HTTPS against a PINNED, hardcoded base URL (never from this file, never user-supplied) -- see web/app.py's curriculum_packs route. Source files for each pack live at curriculum/downloadable_packs/<dir>/ in this repo, never curriculum/templates/ (that would defeat the point -- see REMAINDER_PLAN.md R8.1). Installing a pack copies its files into curriculum/templates/<dir>/.

packs.label: Maths — Class 3 🇮🇳 (general)
packs.description: Place value, adding, times tables and fractions -- general topics, not tied to any specific board.
packs.licence: 100% Mentar-authored / reused generic content. Not aligned to NCERT, CBSE, ICSE, or any state board (see docs/CONTENT_LICENSES.md §2b).
